value.rationale: A complete, natural four-oscillator finite-network classification identifies two singular twist leaves at which orbit-period statistics have an exact inverse-time tail and divergent mean, while every other leaf has finite mean. It provides the explicit critical locations, an observable Haar-law, and a sharp adjacent-center slowdown. The facts quantify otherwise qualitative conservation and integrability results and isolate a usable boundary between finite and infinite typical return-time expectations.
